use_case.name: Q2 2026 Supplier Performance Report — Multi-Source Synthesis
use_case.description: GAIK synthesises four quarterly procurement documents (KPI spreadsheet, quality-audit report, meeting notes, incident log) into a structured, cited Markdown report with evidence index; a procurement manager reviews and approves the draft before release.

business_spec.current_process: A procurement analyst manually combines a KPI spreadsheet, a supplier quality-audit report, procurement meeting notes, and a delivery-incident log each quarter to produce the supplier performance report for procurement management.
pain_points: Slow manual assembly of heterogeneous source documents
Report claims are difficult to trace back to source documents
business_spec.proposed_solution: MultiSourceReportGenerator synthesises all four sources into a structured, cited Markdown report (output/report.md) and evidence index (output/evidence_index.json). A mandatory procurement-manager review gate prevents release of unapproved drafts.
success_criteria: Complete cited draft produced faster than manual method
All KPI calculations are correct and rounded to one decimal place
Data conflicts (e.g. EUR 410,000 vs EUR 405,000) are explicitly disclosed rather than silently resolved
business_spec.expected_value: Faster, consistent, evidence-grounded quarterly reporting with reliable calculations, inline source references, and an audit trail.
risks: Hallucinated facts not present in any source document
Silent resolution of data conflicts without disclosure
Omitted agreed actions or named owners
Premature release of an unapproved draft
business_spec.poc_goal: Given poc_input_bundle.json (four synthetic Q2 2026 sources), running 'python run_poc.py --input <path-to-poc_input_bundle.json>' must produce non-empty output/report.md and parseable output/evidence_index.json. The report must: carry the exact title 'Q2 2026 Supplier Performance Report'; contain all six required sections (Executive Summary, KPI Overview, Supplier Findings, Quality and Delivery Risks, Actions and Owners, Source References); include a KPI table with values Overall 299/91.6%/26550/2.0%/EUR867000, Nordic 135/85.2%/13500/3.1%/EUR405000, Baltic 97/96.9%/9700/1.0%/EUR194000, Alpine 67/97.0%/3350/0.6%/EUR268000; reference all four source filenames with [source_file] citations; disclose the EUR 410,000 meeting-note approximation vs EUR 405,000 workbook figure; capture audit score 72/100, major findings, three Nordic incidents with two assembly delays, conditional status and 85/100 release threshold, named owners Lena Hoffmann and Marko Laine with due dates, Baltic preference, and Alpine single-source risk. Use Windows-safe ASCII console status text.

data_sources: local files resolved relative to poc_input_bundle.json
security_constraints: Use only supplied evidence — no web browsing or external enrichment
External model API (Azure OpenAI) is permitted
Synthetic internal procurement data — no personal data
Evidence index provides the PoC audit trail

prohibited_behavior: Do not invent actions, owners, deadlines, suppliers, or external market facts
Do not silently use EUR 410,000 as the exact Nordic spend
Do not claim the report is manager-approved; the PoC produces a draft for review

fields.title: Executive Summary
fields.instructions: Summarize overall Q2 supplier performance, identify the main concern, and state the management decision. Use only supplied evidence and cite source filenames inline.

fields.title: KPI Overview
fields.instructions: Create a Markdown table for Nordic Components, Baltic Fasteners, Alpine Sensors, and Overall. Show total deliveries, on-time delivery percentage, total units, defective units percentage, and spend in EUR. Calculate from the KPI workbook and round percentages to one decimal place.

fields.title: Supplier Findings
fields.instructions: Give a separate evidence-grounded finding for each supplier, combining the KPI workbook with relevant audit, incident, and meeting evidence.

fields.title: Quality and Delivery Risks
fields.instructions: Describe supported quality and delivery risks. Explicitly identify the approximate EUR 410,000 meeting-note figure versus the exact workbook spend instead of silently choosing the approximate number.

fields.title: Actions and Owners
fields.instructions: Create a table with Action, Owner, Due Date, and Completion Condition. Include only actions explicitly stated in the evidence. Place source citations [filename] in the Action column only; do not add citations in the Owner, Due Date, or Completion Condition columns. If an action does not appear explicitly in a source document's action log or in meeting-note decisions, omit it entirely — do not include inferred or routine monitoring actions.

fields.title: Source References
fields.instructions: List every source file used in the report. Use exact filenames.

target_output_spec.missing_value_policy: state unavailable and omit the claim rather than speculate
validation_rules: All KPI percentages rounded to one decimal place
EUR 405,000 (workbook) used as authoritative Nordic spend; EUR 410,000 (meeting note) disclosed as approximation
All material claims cite exact source filename in square brackets
No invented actions, owners, dates, or external facts

assumptions.text: Temperature 1.0 with reasoning_effort medium is applied to both the writer and reviewer model calls within MultiSourceReportGenerator. If the module exposes separate temperature settings per role, both are set to 1.0.
No retention period, data-residency target, SLA, enterprise authentication product, or deployment topology is specified. These are not constraints for the PoC.
No numerical improvement target (time, accuracy, adoption) has been specified. PoC acceptance is determined by the fixture-based acceptance policy in evaluation_requirements.
The Azure OpenAI gpt-5.4 deployment name matches the model name 'gpt-5.4'. If the tenant uses a different deployment name, the config will need updating.

BPMN swimlanes: two participant lanes — 'Procurement Analyst' and 'Procurement Manager'. Category owners and Procurement Quality Team are external evidence providers and are not modelled as process participants.

Manager rejection path: when the manager returns the draft, the process loops back to the analyst upload step (upload_sources) for correction and re-run, as implied by 'returns it for analyst rework and regeneration'. The rejection is not a terminal end event.

selected_modules.name: MultiSourceReportGenerator
selected_modules.reason: End-to-end module for mixed document inputs to narrative report. Subsumes all parsing, evidence curation, section writing, and review steps. Supports agentic mode, strict review, source references, and evidence index — all required by this use case.
